concept.title: Purpose
concept.abstract: This section describes the purpose, scope, and audience of the Markdown-to-DITA conversion guide. It covers authoring and migration scenarios that help the content converter accurately identify document structure, classify DITA topic types, detect metadata and map hierarchies, and generate standards-compliant DITA-XML. From this section, the AI Agent understands the conversion objectives, content quality requirements, and authoring practices required to produce reliable, low-maintenance DITA output.

conbody.p: This guide provides mandatory best practices for anyone who creates or prepares Markdown (.md) source content for conversion to DITA-XML using the Markdown to DITA converter. The converter is a modular microservice with an embedded AI Agent, which reasons and enriches DITA elements over document structure before transforming it into standards-compliant DITA-XML. These guidelines ensure that the following requirements are met:

li.p: The converter correctly identifies topic boundaries, heading hierarchies, and content types.
The AI Conversion Agent classifies topics accurately as concept, task, reference, or troubleshooting.
The generated DITA-XML output is clean and complete and requires minimal post-conversion cleanup.
Metadata and DITA map hierarchies are detected reliably.
